title: Spectral Enchantment Post-Process Lab
description: Michelle stands in a dark arena facing the DragonDispersion model. The user controls a multi-layered post-processing pipeline where adjusting one effect conserves a shared 'mana energy' budget across all effects. Users must configure bloom, chromatic aberration, film grain, vignette, and color grading passes while managing undo/redo history to achieve a target enchantment look.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load DragonDispersion.glb positioned at (3,1,0) with a slow rotation animation and Michelle.glb at (-2,0,0) playing her idle animation via AnimationMixer. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,8) looking at origin. Add dim ambient light (0.2) and a point light (color #6644ff, intensity 3) orbiting between the two models. Implement a post-processing pipeline with these passes: UnrealBloomPass, ShaderPass for chromatic aberration (custom RGB offset shader), ShaderPass for film grain (time-based noise), ShaderPass for vignette (radial darkening), and ShaderPass for color grading (hue-shift and saturation). Create a right-side HTML/CSS panel with sliders for each effect's intensity (0-100). Implement a CONSERVATION LAW: total mana budget is 200 points. Each slider's value counts toward the budget. When one slider increases, if the total exceeds 200, proportionally reduce all other sliders to maintain the sum at exactly 200. Display current mana usage as a colored bar. Implement MULTI-INPUT COUPLING: bloom intensity on the dragon also increases the point light intensity proportionally, and chromatic aberration strength is modulated by Michelle's distance from center (add a horizontal position slider for Michelle from -4 to 4). Implement UNDO/REDO: store each slider configuration as a state snapshot on every change. Add Undo (Ctrl+Z) and Redo (Ctrl+Y) buttons and keyboard shortcuts that restore previous states, updating all sliders and post-process uniforms simultaneously. Add a 'Randomize Target' button that shows a small preview thumbnail of a random effect configuration the user should try to match. The interaction steps are: adjust bloom, adjust chromatic aberration, adjust grain, adjust vignette, adjust color grading, reposition Michelle, observe mana rebalancing, undo a change, redo a change, attempt to match the random target, fine-tune coupled parameters. Use a dark background (#0a0a12). Render at full window size with responsive resize handling.
